$comment: Closed taxonomy of the survey 'Looped Models for Medical Imaging: A Survey of Iterative Architectures, Test-Time Adaptation, and Feedback'. The five loop families and their branch leaves are Figure 3 of the manuscript ('Loop-centered classification of the 49 primary method and application records') verbatim, in the figure's order; the sixth class is the manuscript's survey class ('Surveys, n = 7, Background only', Supplementary Fig. S1 and Table S1). The state/timescale/risk fields are Fig. 1 of the manuscript. Single source of truth for classification, validation, README/website grouping, issue forms and Claude's classification guide. Changing it requires an explicit maintainer-approved PR that follows a change to the manuscript's Figure 3 (not the other way around), updates tests/test_taxonomy.py and re-runs `python scripts/taxonomy.py --write`. Never add, rename, merge or reorder entries to fit a paper; a paper that does not fit goes to data/review_queue.csv instead.

classes.name: Recurrent, recursive & equilibrium
classes.definition: The loop closes inside a single forward pass: a block with shared weights is applied repeatedly to features, to an output estimate or to a hidden state, or the output is defined as a fixed point of such a block (deep equilibrium models).

classes.name: Unrolled & data-consistency reconstruction
classes.risk: shift in the forward operator A, artifacts
classes.definition: An iterative solver for an inverse problem (y = Ax + n, e.g. undersampled k-space) is truncated to K stages that alternate a physics-based data-consistency step with a learned prior or regulariser, with or without weights shared across stages or a recurrent hidden state between them.

classes.name: Test-time loops
classes.definition: Model state (normalisation statistics, a parameter subset, an input transformation, a prompt or embedding, or a sequence of reasoning steps) is updated at inference using the test case or target-domain data, usually label-free; the loop resets per case (episodic) or carries forward (continual).

classes.name: Data-feedback training loops
classes.definition: The training set is updated over rounds from the model's own outputs: self-training pseudo-labels, co-training or mutual learning between models or views, pseudo-label-guided synthesis, refinement of the training data, or active learning in which an annotator labels the samples the model selects.

classes.name: Human, deployment & lifelong loops
classes.definition: A model is updated around its use: interactive or clinician corrections, human-in-the-loop annotation engines, recalibration after acquisition or scanner shift, continual learning with memory replay, or agents that improve from their own experience.

classes.name: Surveys
classes.definition: Review articles used as background only. They are listed for reference but are not primary method or application records and are excluded from the primary-record count.

aliases.$comment: Spelling variants that are normalised to a canonical name without changing meaning. Keys are compared case-insensitively with spaces collapsed. The family aliases are the short labels of Supplementary Table S1. Raw primary-category labels (for example 'iterative reconstruction', which maps to two different families in the manuscript) are deliberately absent so they go to review rather than being guessed.

hints.$comment: Keyword hints shown to reviewers for rows that need a decision. Never applied automatically.
